SELECT * FROM subject_tbl WHERE LOWER(subject_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{searchKey}) || '%'
AND subject_category = #{category}
AND subject_level = #{level}
ORDER BY subject_no ASC
ORDER BY subject_level ASC, subject_no ASC
ORDER BY subject_level DESC, subject_no ASC
ORDER BY subject_count ASC, subject_no ASC
ORDER BY subject_count DESC, subject_no DESC
